name: Short Cut Curried Chickpea, Onion & Greens Sauté with Garlic Pearl Couscous

ingredients.name: roasted garlic & olive oil couscous mix

instructions.primary_message: Place couscous, water, and oil in a medium saucepan, then bring to a boil over medium-high heat.  Reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, for 8 minutes. (Reserve spice packet for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (135 g) box roasted garlic & olive oil couscous mix
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium yellow onion
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp curry powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the onion is cooking, drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander. Add to the skillet. Wash and dry greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed), then add to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for them to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the chickpeas are warmed through and greens are tender, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (254 g) can garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
1 (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: When the couscous is done simmering, open spice packet, add to the pan, and stir well to combine (it will still be a bit soupy). Return to a simmer and continue to cook until couscous is tender 4-6 minutes more. Cover, remove from heat, and let sit, 4-5 minutes.
To serve, divide couscous and chickpea-greens sauté between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
